About

Hi — I'm Satya.
Cross-disciplinary
by design.

I'm a Strategic Partnership Manager at IGN and freelance UX Designer at Urnatech Studio, based in Jakarta, Indonesia. My work lives at the intersection of people, strategy, and creative systems.

With roots in music business, UX design, and strategic communication, I approach partnerships the way I approach design: by understanding human needs first and building bridges that actually hold.

Currently completing my Bachelor's in Strategic Communication at Universitas Multimedia Nusantara — and still finding time to beat opponents on the tennis court.
